tests.expect: (()=>{const sv=document.getElementById('ink-Q1064');if(!sv)return 'no svg';const host=sv.parentNode;const r=sv.getBoundingClientRect();let X=0,Y=0;for(let y=r.top+12;y<r.bottom-40&&!X;y+=8)for(let x=r.left+20;x<r.right-150;x+=30){if(y>0&&y<innerHeight-60&&!qiUnder(x,y,sv)&&!qiUnder(x+60,y,sv)&&!qiUnder(x+124,y+26,sv)){X=x;Y=y;break}}if(!X)return 'no spot';const mk=(t,x,y)=>new PointerEvent(t,{pointerType:'pen',pointerId:9,isPrimary:true,bubbles:true,cancelable:true,clientX:x,clientY:y,buttons:1});const W=r.width;const cvOf=()=>host.querySelector('canvas.qinkc');const px=(x,y)=>{const c=cvOf();if(!c)return -1;const k=c.width/host.clientWidth;const d=c.getContext('2d').getImageData(Math.round((x-r.left)*k)-1,Math.round((y-r.top)*k)-1,3,3).data;let a=0;for(let i=3;i<d.length;i+=4)a=Math.max(a,d[i]);return a};const line=(x0,y0,dx,dy,n)=>{sv.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerdown',x0,y0));for(let k=1;k<=n;k++)sv.dispatchEvent(mk('pointermove',x0+dx*k,y0+dy*k));sv.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerup',x0+dx*n,y0+dy*n))};const clear=()=>{QI['Q1064']={w:900,s:[]};qiPaint('Q1064')};clear();line(X,Y,10,2,12);qiSave('Q1064');window.__kx=[X+60,Y+12];return QI['Q1064'].s.length===1})()

tests.expect: (()=>{const c=document.querySelector('#q-box-Q1064 canvas.qinkc');const n=((QI['Q1064']||{}).s||[]).length;return (!!c&&cardMarksOn&&getComputedStyle(c).display==='none'&&n===1)||(c?'shown n='+n:'no cv n='+n)})()

tests.name: 폰 다시 필기모드 = 저장된 획이 그림판에 다시 보임 · 덮개가 펜 받음
tests.expect: (()=>{const sv=document.getElementById('ink-Q1064');if(!sv)return 'no svg';const host=sv.parentNode;const r=sv.getBoundingClientRect();let X=0,Y=0;for(let y=r.top+12;y<r.bottom-40&&!X;y+=8)for(let x=r.left+20;x<r.right-150;x+=30){if(y>0&&y<innerHeight-60&&!qiUnder(x,y,sv)&&!qiUnder(x+60,y,sv)&&!qiUnder(x+124,y+26,sv)){X=x;Y=y;break}}if(!X)return 'no spot';const mk=(t,x,y)=>new PointerEvent(t,{pointerType:'pen',pointerId:9,isPrimary:true,bubbles:true,cancelable:true,clientX:x,clientY:y,buttons:1});const W=r.width;const cvOf=()=>host.querySelector('canvas.qinkc');const px=(x,y)=>{const c=cvOf();if(!c)return -1;const k=c.width/host.clientWidth;const d=c.getContext('2d').getImageData(Math.round((x-r.left)*k)-1,Math.round((y-r.top)*k)-1,3,3).data;let a=0;for(let i=3;i<d.length;i+=4)a=Math.max(a,d[i]);return a};const line=(x0,y0,dx,dy,n)=>{sv.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerdown',x0,y0));for(let k=1;k<=n;k++)sv.dispatchEvent(mk('pointermove',x0+dx*k,y0+dy*k));sv.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerup',x0+dx*n,y0+dy*n))};const clear=()=>{QI['Q1064']={w:900,s:[]};qiPaint('Q1064')};const c=cvOf();const a=px(window.__kx[0],window.__kx[1]);const ok=!!c&&!cardMarksOn&&getComputedStyle(c).display==='block'&&getComputedStyle(sv).pointerEvents==='auto'&&QI['Q1064'].s.length===1;clear();qiSave('Q1064');return (ok&&a>0)||('a='+a+' n='+QI['Q1064'].s.length)})()
